AgentProviderV1.title: AgentProviderV1
AgentProviderV1.description: Closed enum of agent providers with a repository-implemented competitive reader. Recognition alone does not add a provider to this contract.

CarRecipeV1.title: CarRecipeV1
CarRecipeV1.description: Closed project-owned pixel-car recipe. It contains no text, color, URL, path, file, markup, shader, executable instruction, or conversation content.

ConnectorCarProposalResultV1.title: ConnectorCarProposalResultV1
ConnectorCarProposalResultV1.description: Generic acknowledgement that one authenticated device proposal was stored for explicit browser review. It exposes no proposal or profile identifier.

ConnectorDiscoveryManifestV1.title: ConnectorDiscoveryManifestV1
ConnectorDiscoveryManifestV1.description: Bounded privacy-minimized discovery result produced by built-in connector readers. It contains no login, email, raw provider identifier, local path, repository, model, prompt, code, conversation, credential, or raw usage component.

ConnectorPairingApprovalV1.title: ConnectorPairingApprovalV1
ConnectorPairingApprovalV1.description: Session-internal ordered batch decision. A separate fresh passkey assertion binds the authenticated session, this complete object, the installation key, expiry, RP ID, and origin before any account is activated.

ConnectorPairingPollResultV1.title: ConnectorPairingPollResultV1
ConnectorPairingPollResultV1.description: Generic pending state or bounded candidate-to-account activation material. It contains no profile, GitHub, fingerprint, passkey, private-label, or reusable server credential.

ConnectorPairingPollV1.title: ConnectorPairingPollV1
ConnectorPairingPollV1.description: Closed polling request that presents one short-lived token and the exact installation-key possession signature for this pairing batch.

ConnectorPairingStartResultV1.title: ConnectorPairingStartResultV1
ConnectorPairingStartResultV1.description: One-time short-lived batch pairing material returned only after the pending transaction is committed.

ConnectorPairingStartV1.title: ConnectorPairingStartV1
ConnectorPairingStartV1.description: Closed anonymous batch-pairing request containing only a privacy-minimized discovery manifest, fresh installation-key possession proof, and non-authoritative rate identifier.

LeaderboardQueryV1.title: LeaderboardQueryV1
LeaderboardQueryV1.description: Closed single-value query for one server-sized Community leaderboard snapshot page.

page.description: Canonical positive page number. The server fixes page size to 100.

LeaderboardSeasonPathV1.title: LeaderboardSeasonPathV1
LeaderboardSeasonPathV1.description: One canonical UTC Monday season path parameter.

LeaderboardSnapshotV1.title: LeaderboardSnapshotV1
LeaderboardSnapshotV1.description: Precomputed bounded direct-token leaderboard snapshot. It contains no account, device, raw daily usage, subscription, model, price, source-count, or private identity data.

ProblemDetailsV1.title: ProblemDetailsV1
ProblemDetailsV1.description: Bounded public error response that carries a request ID and stable code without stack traces, SQL details, secrets, or internal hostnames.

PublicProfilePathV1.title: PublicProfilePathV1
PublicProfilePathV1.description: One canonical public profile handle path parameter.

PublicProfileQueryV1.title: PublicProfileQueryV1
PublicProfileQueryV1.description: Closed single-value query for the current Community profile snapshot.

PublicProfileSummaryV1.title: PublicProfileSummaryV1
PublicProfileSummaryV1.description: Precomputed current-season public profile summary with no account, device, raw daily usage, private label, or internal identifier.

UsageSyncResultV1.title: UsageSyncResultV1
UsageSyncResultV1.description: Non-sensitive acknowledgement for one validated provider-neutral usage synchronization. Derived provider and private anomaly reasons are intentionally absent; an optional coarse recovery action carries no internal cause.

UsageSyncV1.title: UsageSyncV1
UsageSyncV1.description: Bounded provider-neutral Community usage submitted by one AgentAccount-bound device. Provider attribution, accounting revision, ranking, and trust fields are server-owned and intentionally absent.
